name: Priscilu Special Weapons
teaser: The most distinguished gunsmith of Tarkov now builds the most distinguished weapons.
description_html:
ATTENTION: If you are not interested in much better weapons in Tarkov, do not play with this mod. But, if you have already installed the mod, and you are no long interested in playing with these upgraded weapons, just uninstall the mod.

As you all know, Priscilu loves Tarkov. That is why he is always working to bring the best equipment to us. But now he decided to reach a higher level. And in this new level, Priscilu is upgrading existing weapons to make them better in combat.

In this opportunity, Priscilu brings us six new upgraded weapons: HK-416, VPO136, VPO209, M1A, SAG AK and SAIGA.

Obs: these upgraded weapons will keep their original name in the game.

You can play with these weapons with Priscilu’s attachments, what can be seen in the pictures below, or with your preferred attachments. Priscilu’s models for these weapons are available on Priscilu: The Trader. You just need to install the last Priscilu: The Trader version.

Obs: Priscilu Special Weapons are better than original in terms of weight, fire mode, rate of fire, ergonomics, recoil, accuracy and other aspects. Each Priscilu Special Weapons is better in some of these aspects, but some of Priscilu’s weapons are better in all of these.

Let’s take a look at these beasts:

1) HK 416 upgraded by Priscilu

One of the best weapons on this mod.

Recommended ammo 5.56x45: M855A1 or better.

2) M1A automatic upgraded by Priscilu

Different from the original, this Priscilu version is automatic. This, combined with the 7.62x51 caliber, makes this gun one of the most powerful on this mod.

Recommended ammo 7.62x51: M80 or better.

3) VPO 209 automatic upgraded by Priscilu

This weapon is automatic now and combine with the right ammo makes the weapon unbeatable.

Personal message from Priscilu: this is the best weapon in this mod.

Recommended ammo 366TKM: AP-M.

4) SAG AK automatic upgraded by Priscilu

Another weapon upgraded for automatic fire. Simply the best AK in the game and, maybe, the most economical weapon in the mod.

Recommended ammo 5.45X39: BS or better.

5) SAIGA automatic upgraded by Priscilu

It is automatic! Can you imagine an automatic shotgun? But you do not need to imagine because it was already brought to reality on Priscilu Special Weapons, and it can be yours.

Personal message from Priscilu: this is the most fun weapon in this mod.

Recommended ammo 12/70: AP-20 armor-piercing slug or better.

4) VPO 136 automatic upgraded by Priscilu

Another great weapon upgraded to automatic fire. Another excellent option in the mod.

Recommended ammo 7.62x39: BP or better.

All recommended ammo can be found on Priscilu: The Trader.

Do not forget to backup your profile before playing with this mod.

HOW TO INSTALL THE MOD:

1) Download the mod and unzip it;

2) Drag and drop the “user” folder into the SPT-AKI_folder.

IMPORTANT:

If you want to play with Priscilu’s presets for these weapons, you need to install the most recent version of Priscilu: The Trader mod, as these presets are only available there.

HOW TO UNINSTALL:

Delete the folder “Priscilu Special Weapons” of your “SPT-AKI_folder\user\mods” folder.
